results.title: Constitution doesn’t include right to clean water, federal court rules
results.description: The U.S. Constitution doesn’t provide a right to clean drinking water or accurate information from public officials, a divided federal appeals court ruled. results.title: Slovakia says it has summoned Russian ambassador
results.description: Slovak Foreign Minister Juraj Blanár condemned a Russian drone strike on an Security Service building in Kyiv, located near the Slovak embassy's consular section and ordered the Russian ambassador to be summoned.

results.title: US Judge won’t stop Pentagon from firing Stars and Stripes journalists
results.description: A federal judge allowed the Department of Defense on Sept. 4 to proceed with the firing of three Stars and Stripes employees who sued the Pentagon for wrongful termination.

results.title: Kashmiri Pandits Celebrate Janmashtami In Srinagar
results.description: On Friday, Kashmiri Pandits participated in a colourful procession as part of Janmashtami celebrations in Srinagar, with tight security arrangements deployed along the route.
